model: CHT Series CO2 / RH / temperature sensor (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Greystone CHT series combined CO2, humidity and temperature sensors with the BACnet MS/TP output.
summary: The CHT is a Greystone CO2 sensor with optional RH and temperature, talking native BACnet MS/TP. Measurements are three Analog Inputs; relay setup, offsets and altitude are Analog Values, and units, auto-calibration and relay test are Binary Values. Objects for options that are not fitted report a fault.
notes: Points from the object summary table and per-object pages of the setup guide.
AI 2 and AI 3 need the RH and temperature options; the relay objects need the relay option.
Multistate objects are Multi-State Values (MSV) in the guide; listed here as MV.
Access from the PICS: Present_Value is writable on AV, BV and MSV objects.

source.title: CO2/RH/T Sensor CHT Series - Setup Guide BACnet Communication

integration.summary: Set a unique MS/TP MAC and device instance in the menu, then read CO2 (AI 1) plus the RH and temperature inputs if fitted. AVs and BVs are setup values.
setup: Default MS/TP MAC address is 3 and default baud is 9600; both are set in the Setup menu.
Device instance defaults to 381000 + MAC (381003); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
Lower Max_Master from 127 to the highest MAC on the segment to cut token-passing overhead.
gotchas: Objects for options that are not fitted report Reliability NO_SENSOR and Event_State FAULT; do not poll them.
The sensor updates about every 4 s; poll every 5-10 s, not faster.
